scope: Editable exact vector logic and conceptual camp allocation, with complete source-family disposition

decisions.decision: Every directed route names a source port, destination port, item form, release condition and evidence/proposal status. Food, utility and manual carrier families remain separate.
decisions.boundary: Specification identifiers are not runtime item IDs.

decisions.decision: Shore intake feeds cooker through a proposed side adapter; cooked output reaches a finite buffer and an allowed counter branch.
decisions.boundary: Observed source chain; new connector hardware and control behavior.

decisions.decision: Optional assembler has separate ingredient A and B ports and its own allowed-menu output. Both accepted inputs and completed-output space are reserved at cycle start. Completed output dispatch requires its own counter reservation, and does not require consumed ingredients to remain available.
decisions.boundary: Topology is observed; ingredient identities/eligibility, quantities, timing, fuel and new machine geometry are unfrozen.

decisions.decision: Surplus food can enter rear storage. Stored food dispatch is request-controlled and merges with fresh stock only at a gated merge with exclusive slot ownership.
decisions.boundary: New system proposal; no assertion that source advertisements implement reservations.

decisions.decision: Left utility cassette has separate receiving and dispatch paths through an indexed local tray/lift. IN selects either timber or mineral tray; OUT receives from the selected tray and runs to a permitted endpoint. Rear food cassette has independent receiving/dispatch trays and a short horizontal shuttle at prepared-food shelf height, above the closed raw-food cabinets.
decisions.boundary: No mixed pile, hidden whole-house sorting or through-belt across the central aisle.

decisions.decision: Fuel, raw-food storage/sales, hides/fur, cargo/cash, butcher/rack/cookfire/chopping fixtures remain manual. Undefined workshop/greenhouse outputs and steel/oil equipment receive no active recipe route.
decisions.boundary: No invented smelter, refinery, flour, tanning, ammunition, workshop parts or species drop table.

decisions.decision: Raw logs/materials may reach explicitly permitted counters. Raw meat sales require explicit catalogue permission and a separate manually stocked area/mode. Cash collection is a separate staff route.
decisions.boundary: A catalogue permission is required; no universal raw-material or food sale assumption.

decisions.decision: Storage front doors/apron, high left window, rear vent and original right fuel hatch are retained. A continuous blue service spine connects the primary gate corridor to both left and rear storage service aisles without crossing conveyors.
decisions.boundary: Concept allocation; exact dimensions and runtime collisions not validated.

decisions.decision: Product belt terminates at a dead-end staff-side stock buffer. A dashed gray staff-lift handoff moves stock onto the original timber table. Customer face/queue stay outside the fence; staff register/cash access joins the clear internal corridor. Both gate approaches remain bidirectional and free of belts.
decisions.boundary: Physical queue/control logic is a proposal; manufacturer lift-gate clip was not viewed.

decisions.decision: Wrong item remains source-held. Full receiving or output space holds the next item and stops upstream release. No automatic path returns storage OUT to its own IN.
decisions.boundary: Structural graph checks only; no simulation or throughput testing.

decisions.decision: Manual rod acquisition and mechanized shore intake are alternative source phases. Optional manual loading from a rack into an intake is explicitly a new proposal, not source-observed serial topology.
decisions.boundary: No claim that rods must feed the machine, or that this loading port exists in the reference.

independent_review_status.boundary: Concept specification only, not a runnable inventory engine, frozen SKU/recipe table, exact world-scale layout, mesh collision or runtime navigation certification. Static art package, research and GitHub verification remain separate mandatory gates; no task-wide approval.

limitations: No material processing recipes, capacities, rates or costs frozen.
The physical body of the heater stays clear of the storage apron; pale halo is warmth visualization.
Optional assembly pad is a reservation on the spatial plan; its full two-input topology is on D07.1.

revision_repairs.fix: Utility IN/OUT directions and class selection made explicit, with both timber/mineral options.
Stock-buffer-to-counter connection corrected to manual staff lift.
Added continuous service access from gate corridor to left and rear service aisles.
R-F01 is explicitly a new optional manual-loading proposal; source phases are not asserted as serial.
Assembler joint input/output reservation is a cycle-start rule; completed output dispatch uses its own destination reservation.
Synchronized rear prepared-food shelf-height tray/shuttle and low utility tray/lift terminology with root storage r3.

source_input_amendments.applied_change: Shelf-height rear food sleeves above original closed raw-food cabinets; low utility sleeves remain below original left window. Root storage r3 and critic require local horizontal food shuttle, utility lift.
